WIZARD-ATHANOR.description: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{SpellPowerPower}[/blue] [purple]Spell Power[/purple].
WIZARD-ATHANOR.flavor: The fire never goes out, for what it burns is not wood.
WIZARD-ATHANOR.title: Athanor
WIZARD-CURSE_TABLET.description: The first time each turn you apply a [gold]debuff[/gold] to an enemy, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
WIZARD-CURSE_TABLET.flavor: A casting medium of ancient witchcraft, carved with the true name of the cursed.
WIZARD-CURSE_TABLET.title: Curse Tablet
WIZARD-DEAD_SEA_SCROLLS.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Epiphany[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WIZARD-DEAD_SEA_SCROLLS.flavor: Too long in salt and darkness. It no longer records knowledge - only silence.
WIZARD-DEAD_SEA_SCROLLS.title: Dead Sea Scrolls
WIZARD-GILDED_SCALES.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Strength[/gold], gain an equal amount of [purple]Spell Power[/purple].
WIZARD-GILDED_SCALES.flavor: Knowledge, or power? Why not take both?
WIZARD-GILDED_SCALES.title: Gilded Scales
WIZARD-MALEFICARUM.description: Whenever you have applied [blue]{Step}[/blue] kinds of [gold]debuff[/gold] to enemies that you had not applied this combat, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
WIZARD-MALEFICARUM.flavor: Of all the wizard's books, the one holding the most - and the most dangerous - contents.
WIZARD-MALEFICARUM.title: Maleficarum
WIZARD-SEALED_LETTER.description: At the start of turn [blue]{Turn}[/blue], add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random [gold]Power[/gold] card to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs [blue]0[/blue] this combat.
WIZARD-SEALED_LETTER.flavor: The seal is unbroken - yet you already know what it says.
WIZARD-SEALED_LETTER.title: Sealed Letter
WIZARD-SPELL_SCROLL.description: At the start of combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Ponder[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
WIZARD-SPELL_SCROLL.flavor: A scroll of common spells. The wizard has never once needed to read it.
WIZARD-SPELL_SCROLL.title: Spell Scroll
WIZARD-TRIA_PRIMA.description: Whenever you deal [orange]Fire[/orange], [blue]Lightning[/blue] and [blue]Ice[/blue] damage in the same turn, gain [blue]{IntangiblePower}[/blue] [gold]Intangible[/gold]. This relic is disabled this turn and next turn.
WIZARD-TRIA_PRIMA.flavor: Only within this stone do the three elements not explode, but lie quietly together.
WIZARD-TRIA_PRIMA.title: Tria Prima
WIZARD-WARM_CANDLE.description: Every time you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]{Threshold}[/blue] cards, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
WIZARD-WARM_CANDLE.flavor: The ash piles deeper, and the flame is never seen to dim.
WIZARD-WARM_CANDLE.title: Warm Candle
